title: Your asset workflow, in one place
caption: A quick walkthrough of IIUM KAMS, using a sample workspace.

title: Sign in to your workspace
caption: Use your permitted Google account. New staff accounts require administrator approval.

title: Start with the dashboard
caption: Check asset totals, pending approvals, and the colour-coded asset status chart.

title: Find the asset you need
caption: Open Assets and search by asset tag, name, or serial number.

title: Open a matching record
caption: Select the result to review its location, status, assignment, and history.

title: Register a new asset
caption: Choose Register Asset. Scan its label or enter the tag and serial number manually.

title: Save a complete asset record
caption: Choose the department and room, set availability, then select Register asset.

title: Look up assets by barcode or QR
caption: Open Scan Asset. Use the camera, upload a label photo, or type the code.

title: Existing code? View the details
caption: A recognised asset code opens the matching asset record.

title: New code? Start registration
caption: If the code is not recorded, the system opens registration with the code captured.

title: Staff can request available assets
caption: Open Borrowing, explain the purpose, and choose the start and return dates.

title: Review the borrowing request
caption: Administrators review the request and approve it, or reject it with a reason.

title: Track checkout and return
caption: After approval, check out the asset. Mark it returned when the borrowing ends.

title: Report an asset incident
caption: Staff select an assigned asset, the incident type, discovery time, and location.

title: Keep a record of the incident
caption: The report receives a reference number and appears in the user’s incident history.

title: Record completed maintenance
caption: Enter the resolution, parts replaced, actual cost, and downtime. Select Complete work.

title: Review the completed work
caption: The request shows its resolution and completed status. Close the request after review.

title: Set up your organisation
caption: In Locations, add or edit Kulliyyahs, departments, and units.

title: Define where assets belong
caption: Build the location hierarchy: campus, building, floor, and room.

title: Maintain your asset categories
caption: Open Master Data, add a category, or select Edit beside an existing category.

title: Manage staff access and details
caption: Administrators approve accounts and manage roles, departments, and personal information.

title: Let staff maintain their profile
caption: Regular users can update their Position, Phone number, and Staff ID from Profile.

title: Take your asset register with you
caption: Open Reports and export the asset register as CSV or PDF for review and sharing.

title: Use the system on mobile
caption: The mobile view keeps common tasks in the bottom menu for quick access.

title: Bring your assets into one workspace
caption: Set up your locations, register your assets, and invite your team.
